en: Ibn Abbas said: I slept in Maymunah's house on a night when the Prophet (peace be upon him) was there, to observe how he prayed at night. The Prophet spoke with his family for a while and then slept. The report continues that he rose, performed wudu and used the tooth-stick. The complete report preserves its chain and the circumstances stated by the narrator.
